module: Manages the traffic manager's "sources" (focuses), useful when several players (split screen) must each have traffic around them. A source is a vehicle or a fixed position; the module rotates the traffic focus (gameplay_traffic.setFocus) from source to source at regular intervals. Loaded on demand.
usage: gameplay_traffic_source.autoAddPlayers('default') -- one source per player, rotation every 5 s
notes: The update mode is 'off' or 'default' (only 'default' rotates the sources).

autoAddPlayers does nothing if there are fewer than 2 players (core_multiseat.getJoinedPlayers()[2] nil); it sets trafficClearRadius = 160 on each player vehicle and disables the traffic's enableDynamicValues.
In 'default' mode, after each source change the timer is frozen at -1 until an AI traffic vehicle is reset (onVehicleResetted).
addSource returns the created entry or false; a 'custom' source requires data.pos and data.dir.

resetSources.desc: Removes all sources (resets trafficClearRadius to 0 on the affected vehicles), restores the default traffic focus and re-enables enableDynamicValues.

addSource.desc: Adds a source to traffic. 'vehicle' mode: data is a vehicle id or a {vehId} table. 'custom' mode: data = {pos, dir, speed?}. Other mode (e.g. 'camera'): entry without data.

data.desc: Vehicle id, or table {vehId=...} or {pos=vec3, dir=vec3, speed=number}.

returns.desc: The added source entry, or false if the data is invalid (nonexistent vehicle, missing pos/dir).

removeSource.desc: Removes the source at the given index; if it was the current rotation index, the rotation restarts at 1.

index.desc: Index (starting at 1) in the sources list.

getSources.desc: Returns the table of current sources (direct reference, not a copy).

returns.desc: List of entries {mode, auto, vehId?, pos?, dirVec?, speed?}.

setSourceMode.desc: Sets the sources update mode and resets the rotation state. In 'default' mode, creates a timer and an interval (minimum 1 s, 5 s by default).

options.desc: Options; options.interval = rotation interval in seconds.

updateSource.desc: Moves to the next source (favoring a source whose vehicle is moving faster than 1 m/s) or to the given index, then calls gameplay_traffic.setFocus(mode, source). Called automatically by onUpdate or manually.

index.desc: Forced index; if nil, advances to the next source.

autoAddPlayers.desc: Resets the sources then adds each player's vehicle as a source (multiseat), if at least 2 players have joined. Then enables the update mode.

onVehicleSwitched.desc: Hook called when a player changes vehicle. In split screen, autoAddPlayers is often called before everyone is seated: if the new vehicle is not already a source and there are at least 2 players, calls autoAddPlayers again.

onVehicleResetted.desc: Hook called when a vehicle is reset. If the rotation timer is frozen (-1) and the vehicle is an AI traffic vehicle, restarts the timer at 0.

onUpdate.desc: Hook called every frame. Advances the timer; at the interval, calls updateSource then freezes the timer (-1).

dtSim.desc: Simulation delta time (s), used by the timer.
